summary: Phase S1 ships four lib modules (lib/grammar.mjs, lib/manifest.mjs, lib/preflight.mjs, lib/agents-snapshot.mjs) plus the targeted MODEL_MAP and config/model-map.json entry for xiaomi/mimo-v2.5. The contract surface is fully exported and verified: 10/10 manifest, 6/6 grammar, 9/9 preflight, 16/16 agents-snapshot; npm run test:shipped reports a 9/0/0 partition; npm test exits 0 with 78/78 passing; npm run check exits 0; node scripts/parity.mjs exits 1 fail-closed with modelMapMatches=true and unmapped_count=2 (the expected live state — the new MODEL_MAP entry incidentally resolves measure-ux-browser-review). All documented reason codes are emitted as structured, regex-parseable strings. lib/core.mjs change at 035f54e is exactly one line added (xiaomi/mimo-v2.5 entry). tests/.track-red-files.txt is empty (header only). Live cross-directory hard-link parity verified: 29 agents in source and both full-mirror targets; 13 measure-only entries in Desktop/measure/agents; inode equality confirmed for shared filenames. Anti-pattern probes clean across A1, A3, A4, A5, A7, A8. UX/API ergonomics: signatures consistent with lib/core.mjs (destructured options objects, structured return values); errors structured; lib outputs deterministic. Non-blocking finding: scripts/agents-snapshot.mjs (referenced as a hard Green-gate supplement in the strategy) is not present at HEAD 035f54e; the lib is fully verifiable via tests/agents-snapshot.test.mjs and direct invocation of lib/agents-snapshot.mjs. Recommend tracking this as a follow-on so the operator-facing script lands in a follow-on phase or amendment.

findings.description: scripts/agents-snapshot.mjs is referenced as a hard Green-gate supplement in test-strategy.md §1 (gate configuration table) and §7 ('node scripts/agents-snapshot.mjs is a hard Green-gate supplement for S1 specifically'), and as deliverable #3 in §Phase S1.agents-snapshot ('operator-facing verification script ... Symmetric with scripts/parity.mjs; does not modify any directory itself'). The file is NOT present at HEAD 035f54e — scripts/ contains only configure.mjs, migrate-auth.mjs, parity.mjs, and test-shipped.mjs. The lib itself (lib/agents-snapshot.mjs) is fully implemented and exercised by tests/agents-snapshot.test.mjs, so the underlying contract is verified; only the operator-facing binary wrapper is missing. A direct programmatic invocation of the lib achieves the same diagnostic output (verifyHardLinkSnapshot({...}) returns the structured JSON). This is a non-blocking gap from the strategy because every gate requirement (npm test, npm run check, parity, live hard-link verification via the lib's tests) is satisfied.
findings.location: scripts/agents-snapshot.mjs (absent); test-strategy.md §1, §7, and Phase S1.agents-snapshot deliverables
findings.recommendation: Land scripts/agents-snapshot.mjs in a follow-on phase (or amend the strategy to make the lib-only path canonical). The script should mirror scripts/parity.mjs structure: read env vars (OPENCODE_AGENT_DIR, OPENCODE_AGENTS_TARGET_DIRS, OPENCODE_MEASURE_ONLY_DIR), import verifyHardLinkSnapshot from lib/agents-snapshot.mjs, print JSON to stdout, exit 0 when ok=true and 1 otherwise. No filesystem writes (verification-only).

anti_pattern_audit_evidence.A1: No free-text 'deferred' without (deferred:<owner>) in measure/tracks/controlled_harness_evolution_20260714/plan.md. plan.md has zero 'deferred' occurrences; matches in other strategy files are all properly framed (test-strategy.md lines 53, 54, 56, 64, 113, 128).
anti_pattern_audit_evidence.A3: lib/agents-snapshot.mjs exports EXPECTED_AGENT_COUNT = 29 and EXPECTED_MEASURE_AGENT_COUNT = 13 as named constants; tests/agents-snapshot.test.mjs asserts via assert.equal(EXPECTED_AGENT_COUNT, 29, ...) — labeled-integer companions, never bare integers. tests/manifest.test.mjs probes 'agent count: <n>' labeled-integer format (lines 100–109).
anti_pattern_audit_evidence.A4: tests/preflight.test.mjs line 138–142 asserts the all-tilde plan cannot satisfy the all-green preflight contract (assert.equal(result.ok, false)); tests/agents-snapshot.test.mjs line 309–324 asserts empty_source:<path> rejection (never a vacuous ok:true). Both negative-control tests are present and passing.
anti_pattern_audit_evidence.A5: tests/grammar.test.mjs lines 43–47: parseTaskLine('- [x] Done task') returns {status:'x', evidence:'missing_sha'} — [x] without SHA is recorded as structured failure. tests/grammar.test.mjs lines 49–53: parseTaskLine with a 7–40 hex SHA records evidence:'sha:<hex>'.
anti_pattern_audit_evidence.A7: tests/green-gate.test.mjs 'A7 analog' (line 109) explicitly tests that a filename containing the bare English word 'red' (not-actually-red-fixture.test.mjs) is NOT classified as track-red. lib/green-gate.mjs partitionTests uses exact-path matching only.
anti_pattern_audit_evidence.A8: tests/agents-snapshot.test.mjs lines 113–135 assert verifyHardLinkSnapshot rejects symlinks via symlink_detected:<path>; lines 336–356 assert anti-pattern A8 strengthening — symlink-only target yields symlink_detected:<path>, not dev+ino inheritance. lib/agents-snapshot.mjs uses lstatSync(...).isSymbolicLink() before any dev+ino comparison.

ux_api_ergonomics_evidence.signature_consistency: All four lib modules follow lib/core.mjs conventions: destructured options objects for complex inputs ({sourceDir, fullMirrorDirs, measureOnlyDir}), structured return values ({ok, reason?, warnings?}), sorted output for stable iteration (agents-snapshot sorts file names, computeStabilityHashes sorts input paths, manifest agentNames are sorted).
ux_api_ergonomics_evidence.error_structured: Every failure emits a regex-parseable string: drift:agent:<file>, drift:extension, schema_version_mismatch, missing_reference:<name>, unmapped_model:<name>, marker_grammar:legacy_in_active_run, no_completed_tasks, empty_source:<path>, missing_file:<path>, extra_file:<path>, content_mismatch:<path>, not_hard_link:<path>:<dev>:<ino>, symlink_detected:<path>. classifyLinkError maps EXDEV→cross_filesystem, EPERM→permission_denied, EROFS→readonly_filesystem.
ux_api_ergonomics_evidence.env_overridable: partial — the test file (tests/agents-snapshot.test.mjs) reads OPENCODE_AGENT_DIR, OPENCODE_AGENTS_TARGET_DIRS, OPENCODE_MEASURE_ONLY_DIR env vars for live-behavior probes, but the lib itself uses homedir-anchored defaults. This mirrors scripts/parity.mjs's pattern. The strategy references this as the documented override surface; the lib does not need its own env reader because callers can compose defaults with env reads. Pass-with-note.
ux_api_ergonomics_evidence.deterministic: All four lib modules are pure functions over their inputs. No Date.now(), Math.random(), or process.hrtime() in any of lib/grammar.mjs, lib/manifest.mjs, lib/preflight.mjs, lib/agents-snapshot.mjs. formatPreflightError and formatSnapshotError are template-literal-only with no time/random tokens. tests/agents-snapshot.test.mjs line 282–291 explicitly asserts verifyHardLinkSnapshot output does not embed Date.now().toString().
ux_api_ergonomics_evidence.contract_match: Every documented symbol is exported: CANONICAL_REGEX, isTaskStructurallyBlocked, classifyMarker, parseTaskLine (lib/grammar.mjs); loadManifest, validateManifest, computeStabilityHashes (lib/manifest.mjs); runPreflight, formatPreflightError (lib/preflight.mjs); EXPECTED_AGENT_COUNT, EXPECTED_MEASURE_AGENT_COUNT, MEASURE_ONLY_PATTERN, DEFAULT_SOURCE_DIR, DEFAULT_FULL_MIRROR_DIRS, DEFAULT_MEASURE_ONLY_DIR, verifyHardLinkSnapshot, verifyHardLinkRelationship, compareHardLinkInventory, classifyLinkError, formatSnapshotError (lib/agents-snapshot.mjs).
